what: Lineage is the world's largest temperature-controlled warehouse owner. It stores frozen and chilled food for producers and retailers, and handles the logistics of moving it.
customers: Food producers, retailers and distributors who need frozen and chilled storage near production and markets.
money: cold storage rent and handling fees
moat: Cold stores are expensive to build, sited next to food plants and ports, and almost impossible to permit in built-up areas. Lineage owns more of them than anyone.
risks: A $218M net loss and free cash flow of only $26M against $6.8B of debt
Food producers have been running down inventories, which empties warehouse space
Occupancy has fallen since the 2024 listing and the share price with it
opportunities: Revenue has been steady around $5.4B through the downturn
Analysts see about 28% upside, with 20 covering the stock
Food inventories cannot fall forever, and almost no new cold storage is being built
watch: Same-store occupancy and warehouse segment net operating income.
